name: Load Balanced on Active Cells (LBAC)
definition: A parallel isosurface extraction algorithm based on the data parallel paradigm with load balancing strategy based on the total number of active cells. It represents the third class of parallel algorithms.
summary: LBAC is a parallel isosurface extraction algorithm that partitions a 3D volume along the Z-axis and dynamically balances computational workload by equalizing the number of active cells among worker processes.
